changes.scientific_rationale: The complete main/appendix inventory covers task refusal/sentiment, fabricated-link summarization, harmful-request demonstrations, training variants, retained math capability and logit/similarity analyses. Its evaluated decisions concern target task completion/refusal/correctness; the response-selected logits and similarity analysis do not establish an original binary injection-input classifier. The absence follows complete method scope, not missing outcome reporting.

The complete method inventory covers learned attack triggers, verifier-scored payload execution, transfer trials, RAG-survival and deployed-agent demonstration. Retrieval survival is pre-answer but measures retention/retrieval of the adversarial resource, not whether input contains injected instructions. Other scored decisions require target replies. None is a separate binary injection-input evaluation.

Complete original empirical scope consists of generated dialogue/behavior and offensive-code demonstrations alongside cited studies. This is not excluded just because it is called a review: its actual original demonstrations have been considered. They evaluate generated replies/code, with no original binary injection-input classifier experiment in the complete method inventory.

The complete TestART inventory evaluates Java unit-test generation, repair, compilation/execution, coverage, mutation behavior and generation baselines across datasets. These are software-test correctness/sufficiency tasks. They do not classify malicious versus benign injected-instruction input, even though the text matches the bibliographic discovery predicate.

The complete method/appendix inventory evaluates personal-information extraction, profile modifications and adaptive extraction defenses. Regex, spaCy/BERT and other pre-answer methods extract personal-information fields; they are not binary injected-instruction input classifiers. Injection constructions here are defensive interventions evaluated through downstream extracted values. This is a task/unit exclusion, not an assumption based on an incomplete excerpt.

Complete generation settings, feature construction and comparison methods establish a corpus-pair decision about generating model/distribution or sentiment-steering condition. Perplexity and distribution tests require generated-output corpora. Binary same/different corpus testing is not per-input malicious/benign injection classification.

Complete main/appendix method scope evaluates generated target responses for policy adherence under conflicting user requests, boosters and system-complexity variants, plus an output-based jailbreak comparison. Appendix stratifications reuse that same evaluation. There is no separate original binary injection-input classification experiment.

Complete model, training, OWASP category and probe-suite scope evaluates generated target responses under fixed garak vulnerability tests. Training safety variants do not convert response failure aggregation into a binary input-classifier evaluation. Original evaluated units remain target responses, including the injection-related suites.

Complete method and appendix scope covers output watermarks, detector baselines, adaptive removal, transformations, and auxiliary output-quality/perplexity evaluations. The decisions classify generated/suspect text for a watermark or quality. A prompt injection that induces the output watermark is not itself an input-detection evaluation; all relevant detector decisions depend on generated text.

The complete substantive source proposes a prompt gateway, audits, provenance/risk controls and execution optimizations. The original internal-test mentions concern gateway latency and caching/parsers; they do not evaluate malicious/benign injection classification. The proposed input procedure is considered, but the work does not conduct an original binary input-classifier experiment. This exclusion follows the complete described study design, not the absence of performance values or reconstructable counts.

reviewed_unchanged.rationale: The completed inventory includes an input query guardrail as well as the TAP target-response evaluation. Clarify separate binary injection-input evaluation versus harmful-query screening/end-to-end guardrail toggles; undisclosed internal architecture is not itself an exclusion.

Additional textual appendices describe attacks and output/system-prompt defenses. Determine whether remaining screenshots introduce a materially different method; their mere existence is not grounds for incompleteness.

scope: Whole-work method/task judgments only. No outcomes/counts/assurance classification; no sampling or B2. Partial source histories remain preserved.
